scope: Four-hour learning and optimizer pilot. No capacity reduction. Retain Conformer LayerNorm and floating activations; only transformer linear matrices become ternary. Teachers screen the 32-clip gate, but training uses inherited ground truth only. Development is reused validation, not an untouched test. Medical symptom data do not qualify TCCC/drug/dose recognition. Revised onset: three sustained feature frames plus a 100 ms hold; prefix/gain augmentation on training inputs. Original and transformed digit learning gates are both required. Four-hour budget includes all gates.

augmentation.scope: All training clips in gate, benchmark and comparison; development and monitor decoding retain original audio. Only the known synthetic 200 ms zero prefix is removed from digit clips.

extra_gate: All eight digit clips exact at prefix 0/600 ms x gain 0/-24 dB, two consecutive checks.
